instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to use the stimpak on himself (inject it into his own arm), but the page offers no verb for using or applying an item — only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse. The only way an item moves is offer/accept, which would put the stimpak in someone else's hands, not into Glitch's arm; and the supported end states (a person holding an item, being in a room, or having spoken) do not capture self-administration.
